cycles.title: Cycle Views
cycles.description: Audience-specific views over the APIOps Cycles method graph.
cycle.capability-productization-cycle.de: A cycle for turning business capabilities into reusable digital capabilities before selecting the implementation style.
cycle.capability-productization-cycle.pu: Identify and productize reusable digital capabilities before deciding whether the delivery style should be APIs, events, files, streams, data products, AI-enabled services, direct integration, or a hybrid pattern.
cycle.api-productization-cycle.title: API Productization Cycle
cycle.api-productization-cycle.descripti: The API-focused APIOps Cycles journey for productizing, designing, delivering, publishing, and improving APIs.
cycle.api-productization-cycle.purpose: Preserve the current API-focused method journey for teams that already know the intended delivery style is an API product.
cycle.integration-productization-cycle.d: A cycle for productizing reusable integration capabilities before selecting a concrete integration pattern.
cycle.integration-productization-cycle.p: Guide reusable integration capability design before choosing APIs, events, files, streams, data products, direct integration, or hybrid patterns.
cycle.ai-augmented-design-cycle.title: AI-Augmented Design Cycle
cycle.ai-augmented-design-cycle.descript: A cycle view showing where AI assistance, governance, and human validation can support method work.
cycle.ai-augmented-design-cycle.purpose: Show where LLMs, MCPs, AI-assisted design, AI-generated contracts, AI governance, and human validation fit into the method.
cycle.capability-productization-cycle.st: Frame the business need as a reusable capability before choosing the implementation style.
Capture consumer requirements, onboarding needs, constraints, service expectations, and producer responsibilities.
Use requirements and constraints to choose architecture and platform capabilities.
Design the selected solution mechanism and interface contract.
Deliver and operate the selected solution mechanism.
Assure quality, governance, and readiness before release.
Publish capability information so consumers can discover, request, onboard, and get support.
Monitor capability health, consumer outcomes, reliability, reuse, and improvement opportunities.
cycle.template.intent-fit.title: Intent & Fit
cycle.template.intent-fit.description: Capture the business outcome, consumers, producers, scope, constraints, and decision status.
cycle.template.requirements.title: Requirements
cycle.template.requirements.description: Gather expert input using the recommended questions. Treat answers as inputs to design decisions, not final design decisions.
cycle.template.architecture-decision.des: Compare viable architecture choices against the gathered requirements, evidence, risks, and open questions.
cycle.template.api-architecture-decision: Document API architecture, platform, security, lifecycle, and publishing decisions.
cycle.template.integration-pattern-decis: Compare APIs, events, files, streams, data products, direct integration, and hybrid options against requirements.
cycle.template.ai-assistance-plan.title: AI Assistance Plan
cycle.template.ai-assistance-plan.descri: Describe where AI may draft, compare, validate, or summarize, and what evidence it may use.
cycle.template.human-validation.title: Human Validation
cycle.template.human-validation.descript: Document who validates AI-assisted outputs and which decisions require human accountability.
cycle.template.adr.title: Architecture Decision Record
cycle.template.adr.description: Record the selected decision, rationale, alternatives, consequences, evidence, and follow-up actions.
cycle.ai.overlay.strategy.assistance: Use AI to summarize stakeholder input, detect capability candidates, and draft questions for unresolved assumptions.
cycle.ai.overlay.strategy.validation: Business owners and architects validate capability scope, value, consumers, and risks before decisions are accepted.
cycle.ai.overlay.design.assistance: Use AI to draft candidate contracts, compare interface styles, and identify missing requirements or inconsistencies.
cycle.ai.overlay.design.validation: Designers, architects, security, and domain experts validate generated contracts and design decisions.
cycle.ai.overlay.audit.assistance: Use AI to check evidence completeness, summarize audit findings, and propose remediation questions.
cycle.ai.overlay.audit.validation: Governance, security, legal, and accountable owners validate audit conclusions and release readiness.
